test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the idiom that best describes the underlined segment.

You shouldn’t stress much. __This unpleasant situation could be hiding something positive in it.__

options.text: hit the nail on the head
every cloud has a silver lining

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"every cloud has a silver lining" **means that every difficult or unpleasant situation has some positive aspect to it. (हर बादल के पीछे कुछ अच्छा छुपा होता है)
 
• Example: "Losing his job was difficult, but he soon realized that every cloud has a silver lining when he found a better opportunity."
 
• Hence, The correct idiom is** 'every cloud has a silver lining.'**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 3.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) over the moon** (बहुत खुश) - This idiom means extremely happy or delighted, which doesn't fit the context of finding something positive in an unpleasant situation.
 
• **Option 2) hit the nail on the head **(सही बिंदु पर जाना) - This idiom means to describe exactly what is causing a situation or problem, which doesn't convey the idea of finding something positive in a difficult situation.
 
• **Option 4) on cloud nine **(बहुत खुश) - Similar to "over the moon," this idiom means extremely happy or delighted, which is not relevant to the context of finding positivity in a challenging situation.

112:T97d,

The correct answer is **'Option 4'**
